thread:
maya-recruiter: Heads-up: Product wants to change scorecard weights for IC roles to 60% technical / 30% product-fit / 10% culture. They want the new weighted score surfaced in Greenhouse and our hiring dashboards. Need input on migration strategy and whether we can keep historical comparability.

alex-talent: Do we have scorecard versioning in GH today? I think we just edit the template which overwrites prior? Not ideal.

nora-peopleops: Correct, default GH templates overwrite. Proposal: create a new template "Scorecard v2" and add a custom candidate field "scorecard_version". That way new interviews use v2, old ones stay as-is. For analytics we can compute a derived weighted score and store it in a new custom field rather than mutating historical answers.

sam-eng: Downstream note: BigQuery ETL expects a single weighted_score column. Migration needs to write both old_weighted_score and new_weighted_score and flag which is primary. Also include computed_timestamp so teams know when we recalculated.

maya-recruiter: rough migration plan I sketched: (1) create GH template v2 (2) add GH custom fields: scorecard_version, computed_weighted_score_v2, computed_at_v2 (3) run a backfill job that reads old raw answers, applies new weights, writes computed_weighted_score_v2 (no overwrite of original answers) (4) update hire dashboard to show computed_weighted_score_v2 and fallback to legacy weighted_score if none.

lydia-ops: Comms/training: we should add a short FAQ explaining rationale and examples showing how a candidate's ranking could shift after reweighting. Also update interviewer guide and add a note in the panel invite template.

alex-talent: Quick question about handoff: will Greenhouse webhooks change payloads? If we add computed fields GH will still send interview_created/updated events but with extra fields. Our ETL must ignore nulls.

caleb-hr-bot: Draft ticket created: https://gh.example/board/1234 - migration epic + test plan. Backfill window proposed: Saturday 02:00-04:00 PT.

sam-eng: We need a test matrix: sample jobs (IC, manager), sample historical interviews, and a dry-run that outputs diffs. I can run dry-run in staging. Volunteers for validation?

maya-recruiter: I can provide 30 sample interviews across levels. Also want to keep a CSV mapping of old raw scores -> new weighted result for audit.

nora-peopleops: Policy question: do we treat computed_weighted_score_v2 as authoritative for decisioning immediately after backfill, or do we wait until managers are notified? Recommend wait 48h for comms + manager signoff window.

lydia-ops: agree on 48h hold. Also recommend a banner in the dashboard: "New scorecard weights applied on [date]. See FAQ."

sam-eng: technical action items: (A) staging dry-run by Wed EOD (B) backfill script ready by Fri (C) production backfill Sat 02:00 PT. I'll own staging run.

maya-recruiter: comms/action: (1) create FAQ + sample before/after CSV (maya) by Thu; (2) update interview guides + template (lydia) by Thu; (3) send managers notice 3 biz days before migration (nora).

caleb-hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: migration prep sync Thu 10:00am PT.

alex-talent: one last ask: update routing rules used by interview-assignment service. It currently thresholds on legacy weighted_score. We'll need a rollout plan to flip to v2 after a grace period.

nora-peopleops: good catch. Add to rollout checklist: update routing, update candidate scoring API, validate automation.

maya-recruiter: thanks all. If no objections, i'll create the GH template v2 tonight and tag owners on the migration ticket. :sparkles:
